data_point: Already running an established ERP with a full in-house accounting team
run_when: Job posts mention NetSuite or QuickBooks Enterprise.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company already runs NetSuite, QuickBooks Enterprise or another ERP with a full in-house accounting team.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies.
yes_when: Job posts require NetSuite or QuickBooks Enterprise AND there is a finance team of several people
no_when: They're on a lightweight tool, or have no finance team
unknown_when: Only the ERP or only the team is known

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
